method: sim.montecarlo.run_trials: simulated IQ (SimWorld.render_iq) -> caf_estimate -> calibration -> solve for a 20 dBW, 10 kHz noise jammer at the point, pairs by the tasking rule, 1 s captures, draw_errors=True (every trial draws satellite ephemeris, oscillator, site clock and per-pair TDOA bias errors from the configured one-sigma uncertainty, operator-grade or every satellite at TLE-grade; the solver assumes the same sigmas), uncalibrated or calibrated against the configured reference in the jammer's channel. Propagation media ('media'): 'drawn' draws one VTEC |N(0, 30 TECU)| and one zenith delay |N(0, 2.4 m)| per trial, applied at every ground end (the simulator's single world-wide value: the fully correlated case of the solver's per-end model); 'fixed-N' applies N TECU and 2.3 m in every trial; 'off' has no media and a solver without media terms; 'unmodelled-30' applies 30 TECU and 2.3 m to a solver without media terms. The media variants of a row share its seed, so only the media differ. Miss = horizontal distance from the truth; containment = fraction inside the solver's own 95 % ellipse (NEES <= 5.99); mean NEES 2 is ideal.
